Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Used for all detector inference and feature extraction operations.

Experimental Configuration: CUDA 12.1 runtime; cuDNN 8.9.2.

Experimental Configuration: MS COCO 2017.

Experimental Configuration: 2,000 train2017 images; K = 20 concepts.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Used for adapter fitting, concept dictionary construction, clean-class concept priors, and threshold development.

Experimental Configuration: 500 disjoint val2017 images.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Used exclusively for fitting the reliability calibrator and selecting reporting thresholds.

Experimental Configuration: 500 separate val2017 images.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Held-out evaluation; no parameter tuning or threshold adjustment after evaluation.

Experimental Configuration: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN; Torchvision COCO V1 checkpoint (fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn_coco-258fb6c6.pth).
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Frozen detector weights; minimum input dimension 480 pixels and maximum dimension 720 pixels; Torchvision default RPN NMS IoU 0.7, box NMS IoU 0.5, and at most 100 detections per image.

Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Frozen COCO-pretrained checkpoints; 640-pixel input resolution with architecture-specific preprocessing; YOLOv8m default NMS IoU 0.7; DETR uses set prediction without NMS.

Experimental Configuration: Batch size = 1; confidence threshold = 0.50; ground-truth matching at IoU ≥ κ (Equation (2)).
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Fixed inference settings and model-specific post-processing across all evaluation images.

Experimental Configuration: Grad-CAM++, D-RISE, Score-CAM, and an object-level concept adaptation of CRAFT.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: All methods evaluated on the same matched-object set, fixed class contrasts, and evaluation protocol.

Experimental Configuration: 20 shared nonnegative dictionary concepts.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Object-aligned concept extraction; concept names assigned after inspecting activation patterns.

Experimental Configuration: Fog, rain, Gaussian/motion blur, and low illumination; normalized severity steps 0–5.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Identical corruption settings across detectors and methods; severity level 3 used as the common comparison anchor.

Experimental Configuration: Guided dehazing, rain suppression, bounded deblurring, and bounded exposure correction.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Applied to the matched clean–adverse–restored triplets; 300 candidate objects per condition at severity level 3.

Experimental Configuration: Graded suppression and bounded insertion.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Five intervention strengths: 0.20, 0.40, 0.60, 0.80, and 1.00; matched nonsemantic spatial controls.

Experimental Configuration: Maximum 5 candidate regions per object.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: 100 spatial controls per region; foreground-restricted sampling.

Experimental Configuration: Intervention batch size = 2.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Small-batch inference to accommodate GPU memory constraints.

Experimental Configuration: Base random seed = 42; all replicate seeds derived deterministically from it.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Repeated-edit, control, and bootstrap seeds are generated from the base seed and are identical across compared methods; audit seeds used in Equation (28) are drawn from a separate derived stream that is never used for calibrator features.

Experimental Configuration: Five concept roles plus an internal undetermined state; directional dead-zone δ_M = 0.01 (margin units); equivalence band ±δ_eq = ±0.05.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: 1,000 audited concept instances for role evaluation (precision over the 902 role-assigned instances, recall over all 1,000); 250 audited cases for multi-label adverse-failure diagnosis.

Experimental Configuration: Independent re-evaluation of each object–concept pair with fresh intervention seeds and held-out image edits (Equation (28)).
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Audit replicates are never used as calibrator features; audit labels are released with the code.

Experimental Configuration: ℓ2-regularized logistic reliability score (development split) with monotone Platt recalibration (a > 0; calibration split); REPORT/UNCERTAIN/ABSTAIN policy.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: Thresholds τ_L = 0.56 and τ_H = 0.70 selected on the calibration split only and frozen before sealed testing.

Experimental Configuration: Pairwise latency and peak GPU memory recorded for all three detector pairs.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: CUDA-synchronized wall-clock timing and peak allocated GPU memory (torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated) under an identical protocol; warm-up and repetition settings are fixed in the released profiling script.

Experimental Configuration: Image-clustered paired bootstrap.
Implementation and Reproducibility Detai: 1,000 bootstrap repetitions, 95% confidence intervals, and Holm multiplicity correction.
